title: Evidence and truth
description: Make claims from current, inspectable evidence and label uncertainty.
purpose: Keep reports and decisions grounded in observed state.
requirements: evidence-and-truth/verify-current: Verify changed facts, repository state, and completion claims with current evidence before reporting them.
evidence-and-truth/avoid-invention: Do not invent facts, commands, interfaces, paths, versions, outputs, or success.
evidence-and-truth/state-uncertainty: State uncertainty with its cause and record unavailable checks as `not run` rather than calling them pass.
evidence-and-truth/check-determinism: Repeat deterministic checks when output stability matters and report meaningful differences.
invariants: Do not invent; verify current facts and changed state; report uncertainty and `not run`.
